cases.question: How do I pause a queue and drain running tasks before changing configuration?

contexts.title: Queue pause guide
contexts.text: Pause the queue then await queue.onPendingZero() to drain running tasks, ignoring queued tasks. Resume the queue after changing shared configuration.
